messages:
carla: quick note — ran the Q3 reserved GPU forecast vs hosted API usage this morning, and theres a mismatch we should act on. put a short summary below. :wave:

kevin: thanks. high level numbers? can you paste the delta by region?

carla: TL;DR: committed vCPU-equivalent slots are ~12% above projected hosted baseline globally; US-West is +18%, EU is +4%, APAC is -6%. that APAC deficit is due to recent customer growth there.

maria: do we have any hard region constraints (quotas / provider-mins) that prevent moving commitments between regions?

carla: yes — provider requires 90-day notice to change committed zone reservations for the Dedicated plan in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. we can shift capacity via burst pools but not reduce committed line items short-term.

kevin: billing perspective: unused committed GPU hours are hitting our cost center — last invoice shows a ~$52k carry from unused committed hours month-to-month. @billing-bot, can you post the current unused-hours metric?

billing-bot: monthly_unused_committed_hours=3245
monthly_committed_cost_usd=274000
projected_savings_if_trim_10pct_usd=27400

jun: i'd rather avoid hard trims that risk latency SLOs for high-priority customers. suggestion: blend 8% trim in us-west into burstable pool and increase predictive pre-warm for likely prefixes. buys time while we re-evaluate traffic patterns. :thinking_face:

owen: what's the impact on 95p latency if we move 8% to burst? any sims?

carla: ran a quick sensitivity sim using our traffic model (assumes same seq-len mix). results: 95p latency +7ms under current load, +22ms at 95th percentile spike (simulated 30% short burst). cost delta: ~$21k/mo saved vs current committed cost.

kevin: can you share the query you used? finance wants reproducible numbers for the deck.

carla: sure. pasted the core query I used to compute regional committed vs used hours:```sql
SELECT region,
  SUM(committed_hours) AS committed_hours,
  SUM(used_hours_hosted_api + used_hours_dedicated) AS used_hours,
  (SUM(committed_hours) - SUM(used_hours_hosted_api + used_hours_dedicated)) AS unused_hours
FROM billing_reservations
WHERE month >= '2026-07'
GROUP BY region;
```

carla: sample output I exported:```
region,committed_hours,used_hours,unused_hours
us-west-2,45200,37100,8100
eu-west-1,31200,30000,1200
apac-southeast-1,18800,19950,-1150
```

maria: cluster note: us-west-2 has two maintenance windows next month that will reduce burst capacity by ~10% for 12 hours each. if we rely on burst for smoothing we need to coordinate schedule.

jun: ok — proposal: trim committed units by 8% in us-west-2 (operationally convert to burstable pool), leave eu as-is, and plan a 3-month review. meanwhile enable tiered pre-warm for high-latency prefixes. action items: carla to file the reservation change ticket, maria to sync on maintenance windows, kevin to update finance forecast.

owen: sg. can we also flag customers that would be affected by partial decommit so success can pre-emptively reach out?

carla: yes — I'll export impacted customer list and attach to the ticket. link to spreadsheet with numbers: https://short.url/3q-gpu-proj

kevin: finance OKs the plan contingent on the 3-month review and a rollback trigger at >15% latency regression vs baseline.

billing-bot: action_created: reservation-change-ticket-#4231 by carla; review-window=90_days

maria: i'll add maintenance windows to the ticket and set an oncall watch for the first 14 days after the change.

carla: thanks all. i'll push the ticket and schedule the sync. stopping here unless anyone has strong objections. :thumbsup:
